title: New method for determining the optimal PEEP in mechanically ventilated ARDS patients.
summary: The aim of the study is to compare a new method for determining the optimal PEEP in invasively ventilated patients with acute respiratory failure with established methods, with respect to the effects on gas exchange and ventilation in these patients.

interventions.name:
PEEP determination:
1.According to the new PEEP step method
2.According to esophageal pressure measurement

PEEP determination:
1.According to esophageal pressure measurement
2.According to the new PEEP step method

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Mechanical ventilation and ALI/ARDS
Exclusion criteria:
Age < 18 years
Declines participation in the study
Clinical requirement for ECMO therapy or PECLA therapy (pumpless extracorporeal lung assist)
Contraindications to PulmoVista 500:
Pacemakers, defibrillators, or other electrically active implants
Patients with damaged skin or impaired electrode–skin contact due to wound dressings
Patients for whom applying the patient belt could pose a risk, e.g., those with spinal lesions or fractures
Patients with uncontrolled body movements
Morbid obesity (BMI > 50)
Pregnant patients
Patients with massive pulmonary edema
Use during electricity-based therapies such as electrosurgery or electrocoagulation
Use in the presence of strong magnetic fields or in combination with other bioimpedance methods
Contraindications to esophageal catheter: injuries/pathologic conditions of the esophagus
